Title: Real-Time Group Dynamics with LLM Facilitation: Evidence from a Charity Allocation Task
Authors: Aaron T Parisi; Nithum Thain; Alden Hallak; Vivian Tsai; Crystal Qian
Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from single-user assistants to active participants in civic and workplace deliberation, evaluating their effects on collective decision making becomes a governance challenge.

Title: From Vulnerable Data Subjects to Vulnerabilizing Data Practices: Navigating the Protection Paradox in AI-Based Analyses of Platformized Lives
Authors: Delfina S. Martinez Pandiani; Ella Streefkerk; Laurens Naudts; Paula Helm
Abstract:
We argue that the ethical integrity of data science depends not just on who is studied, but on how technical pipelines transform "vulnerable" individuals into data subjects.
We develop this argument through an AI for Social Good (AI4SG) case.

Title: The Jungkook Effect: Celebrity Data, Fan Cultures, and the Ethics of Generative AI
Abstract: Generative AI systems increasingly learn from highly mediatized individuals whose creative output, appearance, and voice circulate at global scale.
